tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. A slate graphite in dark, a cool mist in light; the body carries a faint top-left luminance over it.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs and the reading column. Text and text-muted read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: color-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table headers, notices, chips, the top face of raised controls in dark.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on color-bg, color-surface, color-surface-muted, the status -bg tints and every family tint up to intensity-3.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Intros, hints, metadata, axis labels; on color-bg, color-surface and color-surface-muted (4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and table rows. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: New. Control edges (fields, selects, checkboxes): 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a solid 2px outline, 2px off the control, 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links and selected states. A pale steel in dark, a deep slate blue in light; as text it reads on every surface.

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a color-accent fill.

tokens.name: color-ok
tokens.usage: Succeeded, agree. As text on color-ok-bg or any surface.

tokens.name: color-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind color-ok text in badges and notices.

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: Stopped at budget, content notes. As text on color-warn-bg or any surface.

tokens.name: color-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind color-warn text.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, errors, a prompt version that got worse. As text on color-danger-bg or any surface.

tokens.name: color-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind color-danger text; removed lines in DiffView.

tokens.name: family-care
tokens.usage: Ethos family Care (emotional reaction, interpretation, exploration). Swatches and tints; always beside the label name.

tokens.name: family-collaboration
tokens.usage: Ethos family Collaboration (reflection, open question, autonomy support, partnership).

tokens.name: family-judgement
tokens.usage: Ethos family Judgement (calibrated uncertainty, scope discipline, referral, privacy care).

tokens.name: family-curiosity
tokens.usage: Ethos family Curiosity (purposeful question, reflexive question).

tokens.name: family-risk
tokens.usage: Ethos family Risk (sycophancy, false reassurance, over hedging, padding).

tokens.name: color-expected
tokens.usage: New. The faint lit band behind ProfileStrip tracks showing the expected intensity.

tokens.name: color-signal
tokens.usage: New. Open-model signals: a silver, achromatic scale kept apart from the five family hues; shades a reply by a signal value.

tokens.name: color-chart-1
tokens.usage: The one chart series: RateChart beads, whiskers and the route between versions; IntervalBar beads; the Heatmap tint, up to 28%.

tokens.name: color-chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and axis rules.

tokens.name: color-channel
tokens.usage: New. The floor of every channel: tracks, tab and nav grooves, field wells, the Relief motif.

tokens.name: color-rim
tokens.usage: New. The lit edge on the top-left of raised and channelled forms; light always comes from the top left.

tokens.name: color-shade
tokens.usage: New. The shaded edge opposite color-rim.

tokens.name: color-halo
tokens.usage: New. The Relief’s shaded flank and the fine lip under each crest. Used only at low opacity inside Relief.

tokens.name: color-sheen
tokens.usage: New. The Relief’s crest line and lit flank; the sheen a hovered bezel moves toward.

tokens.name: color-bezel-hi
tokens.usage: New. The lit top edge of a raised outline (buttons, the selected tab, chips) and the lower lip of a groove.

tokens.name: color-bezel-lo
tokens.usage: New. The shaded bottom edge of a raised outline and the upper wall of a groove.

families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: One sans for everything people read. Page titles run slightly condensed (font-stretch 88%) for a precise, instrument-like headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I can’t promise a review will succeed, because that decision sits with our assessors.
styles.usage: Transcripts and body copy; keep lines under 72 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, buttons, tabs.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Expressed disposition, read from text. Ethos does not see inside the model.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Mono only for hashes, IDs and model names: never for labels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Mono: hashes, IDs, model names, message references.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, bead offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding, table cell gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card gaps, control padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutters on small screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutters, PageHeader top space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Mono pills, citations, highlights, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, tables, notices, dialogs (+4px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: New. Buttons, badges, chips and every channel: the rounded ends echo the routed channels.

shadow.note: One light source, top left. Raised forms catch it on their top edge; channels hold it on their lower lip.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts only.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: New. Raised controls: buttons, the selected tab, the active nav item, beads. A lit inner top line, then a soft falloff beneath.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: New. Channels and wells: tracks, tab and nav grooves, fields, pressed buttons. A shaded upper wall falling off into the floor, and a lit lower lip.

intensity.note: How much of a family hue shows. Absent shows none. Lowered from 20, 35, 50% so text keeps 4.5:1 on the dominant tint in dark.

tokens.name: intensity-1
tokens.usage: Faint (1).

tokens.name: intensity-2
tokens.usage: Clear (2).

tokens.name: intensity-3
tokens.usage: Dominant (3).

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, captions, axis labels.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Labels, hints, tables.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Body and transcripts.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Card and dialog titles.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: Page titles.

tokens.name: leading
tokens.usage: Default line height.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: The widest the main column grows.
